item.description:
Jazz Brunch is now officially on the schedule for every Saturday here in the taproom! We’re so very excited to introduce our newest free weekly event, open to all ages, family & pet-friendly
If you haven’t experienced Jazz Brunch yet, here’s what you can expect: from the moment the music begins, the taproom fills with that perfect weekend energy… laid-back jazz, fresh brunch plates, great beer, and a room full of people settling in and staying awhile. Friends gather around tables, conversations flow easily, and the rhythm of the music sets the tone for a perfect, easy Saturday. It’s exactly the kind of atmosphere we hoped to create when this idea first came to life!
We’re especially excited to continue working with our house Jazz band, “Four Peanuts”, whose smooth, soulful sound brings everything together. item.description:
Experience Sir John Rutter’s beautiful and moving Mass of the Children, performed by the Asheville Choral Society with young singers from a local Waldorf school – Asheville Waldorf Singers – professional soloists, and world-class organist. Rutter’s beloved work brings together the voices of children and adults in a powerful musical conversation—moving from intimate, reflective moments to the sweeping sound of a full chorus. It is music about connection, hope, wonder, and the extraordinary things that can happen when different voices become one. As part of ACS’s 2026–27 Come Together season, this performance is an invitation to experience the power of live music—and to share it across generations. Saturday, November 7, 2026 | 4 PM
Adult Ticket, $25.00 Event Details and Tickets Central United Methodist Church, 27 Church St., Asheville
Source: LiveMusicAsheville.com

item.description:
Awakening Asheville Whether you've never set foot in a Spirited Improv circle or you've been coming home to us for years, I want to let you know about something new. A single playshop, just two hours, where you can feel the magic for yourself or simply enjoy it again with fresh eyes.
What if one day could remind you what it feels like to be fully human, together?
**What is Spirited Improv "Try it out" Playshop?** A 2-hour playshop of movement, music, story, and unscripted connection. No script, no performance pressure, no experience needed. Just a circle of people willing to show up, play, and see what unfolds when a room lets go of the need to get it right.
**When?** Nov 11, 5:30 - 7:30 pm in Swannanoa
**Who it's for** People craving real connection, creative expression, and a little more Love in their lives. If you're drawn to personal growth, spiritual community, or simply want an evening that feels different from the ones that came before it, this is for you.
**Led by** Jessic

item.title: FelineConduits — Thu Nov 12, 10:00 PM — The One Stop
Bent Creek/Arboretum -- 6 mi, 900 ft. elev. gain — Fri Nov 13, 9:00 AM
item.description:
The Asheville Hiking Group **Sign-ups open Sunday, November 8, 8:00 PM**
This is a walk in the forest along varied trails, including some one-lane gravel roads that are good for side-by-side socializing. It's mostly easy-going on gradual hills, with a couple of moderately strenuous areas. Several trail segments are cobbled together to give us around six miles in all. Not too hard, but not for beginners if you've never done this sort of thing. I give it a 3.5 difficulty level. We'll take a **15-minute** rest around halfway through for a water break and snack if you'd like to bring something.
Well-behaved dogs are welcome, but the Forestry Service requires leashes for all. Sturdy hiking shoes/boots are recommended. Most people won't need poles for this one.
**MEETING TIME & PLACE** We'll meet at Bent Creek River Park. Please come early for sign-in & introductions so we can leave promptly at 9:00 AM.

Manifesting Self — Thu Nov 26, 6:00 PM
item.description:
AVL Digital Nomads **Location Change:** **Disclaimer: In all efforts to keep this Meetup a safe space, we all agree to keep anything said within the group private and confidential.**
Do you want to take your remote working game to the next level? Do you find yourself saying wtf is Manifesting Self??
Well, you’re not alone. Remote working is glamorous, and also presents itself with challenges not seen in the traditional office environment.
Manifesting Self may sound a little out there. Trust me. It’s not. Whether we’ve been in the remote space for years, since the pandemic, or just recently, I’m certain it has changed each of us in ways we never thought possible. Let’s explore that together. The highs, the lows, and everywhere in between. And from there experience growth.
We are so excited to see you, again or for the first time!
Source: AVL Digital Nomads

That’s 12v12 for one court and 11v11 for 2 courts. We usually have less people at the beginning after setup (~7:15pm) and the end of the night (after 9pm). That said, we are growing in attendance so play time is not guaranteed for the waitlist and those who do not sign up. Ready to dodge, duck, dip, dive, and dodge? Come show us what you got with Asheville’s weekly pick-up dodgeball group! We're hosting open play on Thursday night at Asheville Sports Club. item.title: Fun & easy way to play more tennis (please read event description for details) — Thu Nov 26, 7:00 PM
item.description:
PlayYourCourt Asheville Tennis We’re still working to get more people into these Meetups, but our goal is to give PlayYourCourt members a few social tennis outings each week in addition to your practice sessions and Challenge League matches.
These Meetups are co-ed, super laid back, and all skill levels are welcome. Post your skill level and a suggested court in the comments section so we can round up as many players as we can for some tennis fun!
Also, if you’re looking to meet new practice partners or play some matches and you aren’t already in the PlayYourCourt Community, you can go here to see what we’re all about and sign up:
https://www.playyourcourt.com/tennis-community/asheville-nc/meetup/
If you love tennis, we’d love to have you! Be sure and watch the quick video that explains how everything works.
Happy hitting!
- Scott
Source: PlayYourCourt Asheville Tennis
